NewsSection.title: <bold>At the heart of the territories:</bold> <line>news & resources</line>

BusinessSectorsPathSection.title: <line>Tomorrow,</line> <bold>a search better tailored to your sector</bold>
BusinessSectorsPathSection.description: Industry, logistics, crafts or services: location criteria vary widely from one activity to another. Over time, Foncier+ aims to enhance its search by sector to better qualify listings in light of your constraints. This approach will be rolled out gradually.

RegionMapSection.title: <bold>A nationwide supply</bold> <line>of business land</line>
RegionMapSection.subtitle: Over 1,000 listed sites and more than 8,000 hectares available across France
RegionMapSection.description: Foncier+ gathers listings published by local authorities and their partners to give you a nationwide view of the available business land and help you identify who to contact.

AmbitionsSection.title: Connecting business location projects with local areas
AmbitionsSection.description: Foncier+ is a national entry point that showcases business land listings from local areas and makes it easier to reach the local stakeholders behind them.

section1.title: Get a clearer view of available land
section1.description: Access listings published nationwide to quickly spot the sites worth looking into.

section2.title: Get in touch with the right contact
section2.description: Listings point you to the local stakeholders to contact, so you can take your project further and move forward with setting up your business.

section3.title: Never be left without an answer
section3.description: If your search is unsuccessful or you’re not sure who to turn to, Foncier+ can relay your request to its network of partners.

section4.title: A national network supporting projects
section4.description: Foncier+ draws on local authorities, their development agencies and national partners to connect projects with the right contacts, without replacing local support.
